tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, console and code block backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Pane bodies, callouts, boot stage cards. One step off bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Pane title bars, window tabs, status line. Never nest raised in raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px rules and pane borders. Not for borders that carry meaning (below 3:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: buttons, inputs, tags. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface and surface-raised (at least 9.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, line numbers, pane metadata, on every surface (at least 5.7:1).

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: Tango red. Errors, FAILED states, the Raspberry Pi board marker. Text-safe on every surface.

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: Tango green. Shell prompt user@host, OK states, the primary accent. Text-safe on every surface.

tokens.name: ansi-yellow
tokens.usage: Tango butter in dark, Tango chocolate (the Linux console brown) in light. Warnings, the secure world, focus rings.

tokens.name: ansi-blue
tokens.usage: Tango sky blue. Paths in prompts, links, info callouts, the STM32MP1 board marker.

tokens.name: ansi-magenta
tokens.usage: Tango plum. Firmware and ROM stages (VideoCore, boot ROM), numbers in code.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: Tango cyan. The normal world, Linux kernel stages, DT properties in code.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection and the highlighted line in code and console. ink stays readable on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent or ansi-yellow fills: primary buttons, status line mode block.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive emphasis: primary button fill, active tab, active pane border, cursor.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in lesson prose, underlined.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: KERN_INFO callouts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: KERN_WARNING callouts and warning lines in console replays.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: KERN_ERR callouts, FAILED states.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: systemd-style [  OK  ] states, passed checkpoints.

tokens.name: world-secure
tokens.usage: Secure world, EL3, S-EL1/S-EL0, Monitor mode tags and lanes.

tokens.name: world-normal
tokens.usage: Normal world, NS EL0-EL2 tags and lanes.

tokens.name: world-firmware
tokens.usage: Code before any Arm world exists: boot ROMs, VideoCore firmware.

tokens.name: board-rpi
tokens.usage: Raspberry Pi 4 marker in board tabs and legends. Always next to the board name.

tokens.name: board-bbb
tokens.usage: BeagleBone Black marker in board tabs and legends. Always next to the board name.

tokens.name: board-stm
tokens.usage: STM32MP157 marker in board tabs and legends. Always next to the board name.

families.mono: "Ubuntu Sans Mono Variable", "Ubuntu Sans Mono", "Ubuntu Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", ui-monospace, monospace
families.sans: "Ubuntu Sans Variable", "Ubuntu Sans", Ubuntu, "DejaVu Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Course and module titles. One per page.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: The FIP holds BL32 and BL33

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Subsections, pane titles in large demos.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: The ROM code runs before anything you wrote.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: SPL brings up DDR, then loads U-Boot into it.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, prompts, inline code at 0.9em.

styles.name: banner
styles.usage: Proposal: boot banners in hero animations only. Never body text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tag padding, gaps inside a control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between tags and buttons; pane split gutters.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding in bars, buttons and code.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pane body padding, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panes and between lesson blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between lesson sections.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panes, code, console, callouts. Terminals are square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons and tags, to soften small controls only.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Tooltips and popovers floating over content.
